title: TOP STARTUPS
subtitle: VALUATION - 2015 to 2026
outro: OpenAI went from zero to giant.

Follow for the money
nobody explains.
vo: In twenty fifteen, ride-hailing apps like Uber ruled the startup world. Then TikTok's parent, ByteDance, became the most valuable private company ever. SpaceX reached for the stars and the valuations. And when artificial intelligence went mainstream, OpenAI exploded from almost nothing to a hundred-billion-dollar giant in record time. By twenty twenty-six, the private money game is unrecognizable. Who's next? Follow, for the money nobody explains.
